title: docs(governed): ADR-0087, AGENTS.md and the retirement playbook describe the D4 projections and the migration registry as main builds them
body:
Fixes #22667
Clause-②: no

Three governed texts still described `packages/spec/spec-changes.json`, the protocol upgrade guide and `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` as committed files with a regeneration lap. On `main` none of the three is committed. This PR restates 12 sites as `main` now builds them (11 at the first head, site 12 in patch round 1 below). No code, gate, script or published file changes.

Dispatched by `/pm-dispatch skills` seat 2 (PM session `session_011u73oxZ5X95qrARPTeoU6v`, claim `6106319581`), executed in the same session. Tree read: `origin/main` `a2e94c2a05`. The diff is measured from that base, and every gate below ran on head `bd6337b8b`.

## What `main` does (measured before editing)

| Fact | Evidence on `a2e94c2a05` |
|---|---|
| Neither projection is committed | `git ls-files packages/spec/spec-changes.json packages/spec/protocol-upgrade-guide.md content/docs/protocol-upgrade` prints nothing. `.gitignore` lists all three paths. |
| Neither projection has a `merge=os-regen` route | `grep -n os-regen .gitattributes` shows 16 routed paths, and neither projection is one of them. |
| The guide's copy and route went at #22483 | `514bf3c101` (PR #22556) deletes `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md merge=os-regen` and reduces that file to a pointer stub. |
| `spec-changes.json`'s copy and route went at #22485 | `46064dfa03` (PR #22638) deletes the file and `packages/spec/spec-changes.json merge=os-regen`. |
| `registry.ts` is generated and not committed | `.gitignore` lists it. `registry.ts.template` is tracked (`ed1de8c2db`, PR #22706) and holds `STEP18_RATIONALE`, `const step18` and the earlier steps' `conversionIds` / `rationale`. |
| `gen:migration-registry` exists; `check:migration-registry` does not | `packages/spec/package.json` scripts. `check-generated.ts` files `gen:migration-registry` under `UNGATED_GENERATORS`, and its gate was retired with the committed copy. |
| The two projection checks still exist and never report stale | `check:spec-changes` / `check:upgrade-guide` run `--check`: they generate in memory, read nothing on disk, and exit 1 only when generation fails (`lib/projection-cli.ts`). |

All five commits named above pass `git merge-base --is-ancestor` against HEAD with exit 0. A positive answer needs no control leg.

| 11 | playbook `:335`-`:337` | "只改 conversion 的 `summary` 也会过期 … 所以纯散文改动也要 `gen:spec-changes` + `gen:upgrade-guide`" | "只改 conversion 的 `summary` 不欠重生成。它逐字进两条 D4 投影,都不提交;PR 渲染其 diff。" |

The card lists sites 2, 3, 4 and 6 to 11, with site 9 coming from `6100582202`. The dispatch's same-class sweep of ADR-0087 found sites 1 and 5, which describe unlanded work in the same way. The verbatim ruling quotation at ADR-0087 `:219`-`:220` is unchanged, and so is ADR-0120 `:459`-`:460`, which triage ruled to be history. The PR contains nothing beyond these 11 sites: `git diff --stat a2e94c2a05 HEAD` shows 3 files, +37 / -31.

How site 7's count was measured: the table's "Gate that fails" column names eight gates, and six of them still guard tracked artifacts.

- `check:docs`: `content/docs/references/` (225 tracked files)
- `check:api-surface`: `packages/spec/api-surface/` (19)
- `check:authorable-surface`: `packages/spec/authorable-surface/` (14), plus `json-schema.manifest/` (14)
- `check:skill-docs`: `skills/README.md`, `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`

`check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide` are the other two, and their projections have 0 tracked files.

Site 8 differs from the card. The card proposed `check:migration-registry`, but PR #22706 (`ed1de8c2db`) removed that gate after the card was filed. The row therefore names the two gates that do exist and states that there is nothing to commit.

Site 11 differs from the card too. No committed artifact carries a conversion's `summary` any more. It is read only by the two in-memory projections (`spec-changes.ts` `to`, `build-upgrade-guide.ts` table rows) and by their rendered PR diff. A summary-only edit therefore owes no regeneration.

## Acceptance notes

- AGENTS.md section "Touched `packages/spec`?" still says "Two generators have **no** gate at all — `gen:openapi` and `gen:sbom`". `check:generated --reconcile-only` on this tree prints "3 ungated generators", because `gen:migration-registry` joined the list at PR #22706. It is the same family as this card, but it lies outside the AGENTS.md lines this claim declared, so it is not edited here and goes back to the seat.
- The same section's "All of them live in one job — `TypeScript Type Check` … runs its gates **sequentially**" predates this card. Five of the six gates run in `Type Check · source gates`, and `check:api-surface` runs in `Type Check · consumer gates`. Both lanes sit behind the required `TypeScript Type Check` aggregate. Noted only.
- ADR-0120 `:459`-`:460` and `:560` record what that PR ran, and stay untouched as history.

## Patch round 1 (written by the PM seat from the diff on `origin` and the dev's report; head `6cb0d8ecd`)

- **Site 12 — AGENTS.md base `:761`–`:762`, the same "Touched `packages/spec`?" section.** Before: "Two generators have **no** gate at all — `gen:openapi` and `gen:sbom`. Nothing verifies their output is current; the wrapper reports that each run rather than staying silent." After: "Three generators have **no** gate at all. Nothing verifies `gen:openapi` and `gen:sbom` are current, and `gen:migration-registry` writes gitignored output that install, build and test regenerate; the wrapper reports all three each run rather than staying silent." Evidence: `packages/spec/scripts/check-generated.ts` lists `gen:migration-registry` under `UNGATED_GENERATORS` since PR #22706 (`ed1de8c2db`), and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --reconcile-only` prints "3 ungated generators". The claim's AGENTS.md surface was widened to the whole section on the card (comment 6106593221) before the edit.
- Incremental diff `bd6337b8b..6cb0d8ecd`: `AGENTS.md` +3/−2, nothing else. Whole PR against base `a2e94c2a05`: 3 files, +40/−33.
- Line budget after the patch: `AGENTS.md` 1109 lines (ceiling 1116; headroom 7), +1 for the sentence's third line; the playbook and ADR-0087 are unchanged from the first head.
- The first Acceptance note below is resolved by this round; the other two stand.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:三份给 agent 读的受管文本是 ADR-0087 的 D4 进度注、AGENTS.md「改了 `packages/spec` 要重生成什么」一节和属性退役 playbook。里面还有句子把 `spec-changes.json`、升级指南和迁移注册表 `registry.ts` 当作提交在仓里的文件来写。本 PR 把这 12 处改成 main 现在的样子:两条投影只在发布或文档构建时生成，PR 上只在内存里生成并展示 diff;`registry.ts` 在安装和构建时由模板加条目文件生成，不提交。改动只有文字，不碰代码、门禁和发布内容。

**为什么改**:旧句子会让下一个改 spec 迁移的 agent 去跑一圈已经不存在的重生成。本周已有三个 dev 重生成后又回退。旧句子还会让人把 step-18 的说明手改进一个不会被提交的生成文件，改动在下一次构建时静默丢失。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:不发布任何包，不改任何门禁或脚本。ADR-0087 里维护者裁决的逐字引文没有动。回滚就是 revert 这一个 PR。代价是 playbook 删掉了一条已失效的陷阱说明(3 行压成 1 行)，用来抵付新增的模板说明，行数棘轮不变。

**你要做的**:看一遍上面的 11 项清单和补丁轮 1 的第 12 项。同意就给一个 APPROVED review,落地由席位来做。
